introHtml: Koozie counter mats combine the trusted durability of Koozie’s floor mat construction with a compact size ideal for countertops, registration desks, and point-of-sale areas. Made from recycled rubber with a non-slip backing, these mats withstand heavy foot traffic and daily spills while keeping your logo visible. Choose from custom shapes and vibrant imprint colors to match your brand. Perfect for trade shows, retail stores, or office lobbies where first impressions matter.
